A '''clone trooper''' served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] as a [[Clone Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]] in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]]. During his stay on the planet, the [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] witnessed the explosion of a [[Carrier/Legends|carrier]] transporting [[Bota/Legends|bota]], a [[Plant/Legends|plant]] with substantial medicinal qualities. Together with two other beings, the lieutenant speculated on what had caused the explosion.

==Biography==
{{Quote|How many aboard?''"<br />"''Two loaders. And the pilot.|The lieutenant and a Human|<ref name="MedStar I" />}}
[[File:JangoFett-OffPix.png|thumb|right|200px|Jango Fett (pictured) was the template for the Galactic Republic's Clone Army]]
Like all [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]],<ref name="clone troopers">{{DB|organization|clonetroopers|clone troopers}}</ref> the [[Clone Lieutenant/Legends|clone trooper lieutenant]]<ref name="MedStar I" /> was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] and was [[Reproduction/Legends|bred]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]<ref name="SWE" /> to fight for the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="clone troopers" /> In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] served on the<ref name="MedStar I" /> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]<ref name="The Essential Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> planet [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]], where the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Battle of Drongar|clashed]] with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] over the planet's fields of [[Bota/Legends|bota]]&mdash;a highly valuable [[Plant/Legends|plant]] that had extensive medicinal assets. During his stay on Drongar, the lieutenant witnessed the explosion of a bota [[Carrier/Legends|carrier]] at the [[Republic Mobile Surgical Unit 7]]. While the lieutenant suspected that the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] had exploded due to a [[Deflector shield/Legends|shield]] failure, a nearby [[Unidentified Ishi Tib technician|Ishi Tib technician]] stated that such an event was impossible. The lieutenant then asked how many beings had been aboard the vessel, and a [[Unidentified Human (Drongar)|Human]] informed him that there had been two loaders and a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] aboard the carrier. Unbeknownst to the Republic, the traitor [[Klo Merit]] had [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotaged]] the vessel.<ref name="MedStar I" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Freaking shame.|The lieutenant, regarding the deaths caused by the explosion|<ref name="MedStar I" />}}
After seeing the explosion of the carrier, the lieutenant whistled in awe and was quick to assume the event had been caused by shield failure. After being told otherwise, the [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] asked how many lives the tragedy had claimed and considered the [[Death/Legends|loss]] of three people a shame.<ref name="MedStar I" /> Like all clone troopers, he stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall<ref name="SWE" /> ands had [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin.<ref name="Skin" />

==Equipment==
As a lieutenant, the clone trooper wore blue [[Clone trooper armor/Legends|clone trooper armor]].<ref name="MedStar I" />

==Behind the scenes==
The clone lieutenant had a brief appearance in ''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]'', the first novel of the [[MedStar Duology]]. ''Battle Surgeons'' was written by [[Michael Reaves]] and [[Steve Perry]], and was published in [[2004]].<ref name="MedStar I" />
